title: Write a Postmortem Prompt So AI Bugs Never Return
description:
Fixed a bug? Make sure it never comes back! 🔍

✅ Ask AI for a postmortem of the bug
✅ Get the root cause in one sentence
✅ Ask why your tests missed it, then add a test

Day 10 of AI Debugging, the last one in the series. Next up: the new series Agent Harness, Day 1: Give Your Agent a One-Command Check.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to debug with AI the right way.

#shorts #coding #programming #ai #chatgpt #debugging #aitools
comment: Root cause or new test: which would you ask AI for first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: keep the postmortem prompt in a file, so you paste the same four lines after every bug you fix.
